propositions: Bridge orchestration must be extracted into a runner-neutral packaged Python core exposed through Python library, CLI, and MCP interfaces from pip, Homebrew wheel-backed, and MCP Registry/uvx install paths.
Five provider profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) map to corresponding rebar commands with preserved legacy MODE environment variable compatibility.
Legacy direct reconcile callers retain benign results 3/4/75; new provider runner translates benign legacy results to canonical 0 while preserving operational 1 and invalid-invocation 2.

Provider wrappers (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab) invoke exactly rebar bridge run; GitLab schema is vendored with immutable upstream revision and SHA-256 provenance; embedded shell is linted with pinned ShellCheck.
Runner enforces 3600-second timeout, validates pause markers, owns environment validation, and performs strict ticket-store delivery with run id and bot identity on every successful non-paused pass.
